ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*mshta.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*vbscript\\:createobject.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\\.run.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*window\\\.close.*")))
